feedback.jei.circuit_chain.note1: Click any item for its own recipes.
feedback.jei.circuit_chain.note2: Cheapest route: printed board, coherer, tin.
gui.feedback.solder.title: Soldering
feedback.jei.soldering.note: Hand iron: drag along the pad row, pace sets the joint. Or reflow oven. Etched traces lift at their wire's limit. A part whose pad runs hotter than the part can take is cooked. A finished circuit and a wick lift parts off again.
feedback.jei.info.coherer: Open until a nearby spark welds its grains into a wire; it stays welded until you tap it with an empty hand. Each weld wears the grains a little, and a very hard spark fuses them into one lump that a tap cannot free. Shake any conducting dust, such as redstone or magnetite, into the tube to give it fresh grains. A spark is an arc from a breaker or relay opening under load, or an electrostatic generator.
feedback.jei.info.whisker: A wire on a crystal. Right-click with a crystal to seat it, then step the whisker round its 8 spots with an empty hand to find one that works. On a spark it closes the line for half a second.
feedback.jei.info.relay: Put it against an electromagnet. A small current in the magnet's line closes the relay's own line. It wears when it switches under load.
feedback.jei.info.component_tester: Right-click a placed whisker, coherer or relay to read how it responds. With a trace board in the other hand, right-click in the air to read the board.
feedback.jei.info.oscilloscope: Put it against a cable and against a phosphor screen. It only reads: right-click for the last 32 samples. A signal pegged at the top is exact and wrong.
feedback.jei.info.phosphor_screen: Set it on a firebox, heat it, then right-click with an empty hand to seal it. The hotter the seal, the better the vacuum. Pair it with an oscilloscope. Holding it at full brightness burns it in.
feedback.jei.info.wick: A braid of copper wire that soaks molten solder off a joint. With a soldering iron in one hand and a finished circuit in the other, right-click to melt its joints; a part whose two pads both go wet lifts off and comes back as the item you mounted, unless the pads ran hotter than the part can take. A wick lifts a few parts before it is used up.
feedback.jei.info.reflow_oven: Set it on a firebox. Right-click with pasted boards to load up to four, empty hand to take them out: joints are set from the hottest they got and how long they sat above the solder's melting point.
feedback.jei.info.soldering_iron: Right-click a fire to heat it. Right-click with a pasted board in the other hand to open the soldering screen, then hold the button and drag the tip along the pad row. Pace is the skill: too fast and a pad stays dull (cold), too slow and it scorches and the trace lifts, a shaky hand bridges, and a part whose pad runs hotter than the part can take is cooked: it stays on the board but switches nothing. The iron cools as it works, so later pads want a slower pace. Reheat and come back to start again. With a finished circuit in the other hand and a wick in your pack, the same drag lifts parts off instead.
feedback.jei.info.mass_probe: Hang it in an electrolytic cell to read how much metal has plated onto it. Its cut is the cut of the crystal plate it was made from: fine sees detail and not far, coarse sees far and coarsely.
feedback.jei.info.trace_board: Make a substrate on a grinding wheel, lay traces (etched or printed) in a crafting grid, mount parts, paste with solder, then solder it with an iron or reflow oven.
feedback.jei.info.circuit: A soldered board with parts on it, which a wick and an iron can lift off again. It carries elements, speed, noise and joints, and with a tube on it gain and a heater, read with a component tester. A cold joint gives a noisy circuit; lifted traces give a dead one. A Controller, Electric Controller or Computer takes one in its circuit slot (use it on the block): its speed sets how many program steps a second the host takes and its noise how much its sensor readings wobble; with none the host still runs, slower and noisier. A circuit with a tube reads slow and noisy while cold, and a powered host warms it. With a resonator it also carries stability, channels and bandwidth; with a lattice, memory (extra program variables), retention and adaptation. Gain (from a tube) lets a galvanometer and a Geiger counter read fainter signals and lengthens a data link that ends at a block holding the circuit; it counts only while the tube is warm. Clipped into a gun (fire control) it tightens the group and lengthens the rangefinder behind the range, lead and drop readout; clipped into a launcher (fuse control) it sets a proximity or counted fuse from its gain, noise and clock; in a suit optic module its gain widens the scan pulse and the thermal lens and its noise makes a scan miss things.
feedback.jei.info.galena: A rectifying crystal. Seat it in a cat's whisker detector, or mount it on a trace board as a switching part.
feedback.jei.info.pyrite: A rectifying crystal, poorer than galena. Seat it in a cat's whisker detector, or mount it on a trace board as a switching part.
feedback.jei.mixture.free_fall: Only in free fall: on the ground the heavier metal sinks out of the melt
feedback.jei.fire.title: Fired %s coat
feedback.jei.fire.output: The part, coated %s Qu; a chipped coat is made whole
feedback.jei.dip.overrun: Past %s Qu in all the part takes flaws, then dissolves
feedback.jei.info.electrolytic_cell: Fill it with water and wire it to a supply. Hang a metal on top: it dissolves into the water, and the current plates metal back out onto the cathode. The liquid decides which metal plates (water takes the noblest, an acid or a base takes more); the current decides how fast; the band only has to be enough to run it. Hang a metal piece on a side and it takes the coat instead. Nothing stops when the anode is gone. A circuit used on it sharpens the deposit: less of the other metals counts against the purity that makes an ingot rather than scrap or a mixed coat, and a Sensor card can read its deposit, purity and condition. Sneak with an empty hand takes the circuit out once the anode is out. It works as ever without one.
feedback.jei.info.gloves: Worn in the hands slot, a glove of leather or cloth keeps warm work and a weakly live bare wire off the skin, as far as the material stands it: enough to ladle from a lit furnace. A metacarpal plate on the back of the hand punches harder, guards you and lets a bare hand parry, but a heavy one slows your swing; it keeps no heat off.
feedback.jei.info.hand_hammer: Hold it in one hand with one workpiece in the other and hold use: each stroke is one blow, and it keeps striking until you let go or a blow cannot land. Sneak-scroll chooses how hard you swing. Metal too hard or too cold takes no blow, and letting go hands the piece back as it is.
feedback.jei.hot_tool.hot: Heat it to its working temperature first
feedback.jei.info.hot_tool: Hammered out hot: a striking hand tool (the hammer) and the metal pieces, in any arrangement in a crafting grid, with every piece at its metal's working temperature. A cold piece makes nothing, and the hammer wears one point per tool.
feedback.jei.info.tongs: Two rods of one metal at their working temperature, a grip and a striking hand tool (the hammer), in any arrangement in a crafting grid. Held in one hand, they let you carry hot work in the other. How hot depends on what the grip and the arms are made of.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.c: This tank metal states no strength, so its walls hold no pressure.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.pick_part: Pick a part to choose its material and shape.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.needs_haft: A haft is needed to hold this head.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.cannot_: Cannot print: this type is not put together that way.
Cannot print: the action and feed do not work together, or a part's material cannot be built into a gun.
Cannot print: these parts are a gun on paper, but the Engineering Table would not read them back as this design.
Cannot print: these parts are a gun, but it has no firing figures to bake.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bow_limbs: The arms of a bow: three lengths of stock bent to a draw. Their strength sets how hard it shoots.
modular.feedback.desc.part.shield_face: The broad face of a shield. Its material sets what blow it can take; its shape sets what the shield is.
modular.feedback.desc.part.receiver: The body of a gun: it holds the chamber, the action and the stock. Its shape sets what kind of gun it is.
modular.feedback.desc.part.gun_barrel: The tube the bullet runs down. A longer barrel gives a faster, truer shot; its bore sets the caliber it takes.
modular.feedback.desc.part.slide: A sliding block that cycles the action. It lets a gun load itself from the recoil or the gas.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bolt: Seals the breech and works the action by hand, by lever, by pump, by break or by itself.
modular.feedback.desc.part.trigger_group: The trigger and the sear it releases. It is what makes the gun fire when you ask.
modular.feedback.desc.part.cylinder: A drum of chambers that turns a round into line at each pull. A revolver's whole feed.
modular.feedback.desc.part.magazine_tube: A tube of rounds under or beside the barrel. It feeds the action one round at a time.
modular.feedback.desc.part.belt_feed: Pulls a belt of rounds through the action. It feeds a machine gun as long as the belt lasts.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sight: Shows where the shot will go. A better sight tightens the aim, never the gun.
modular.feedback.desc.part.suppressor: Slows the muzzle gas to quiet the shot. It holds heat in the can and gets hot.
modular.feedback.desc.part.muzzle_brake: Vents gas sideways at the muzzle to cut kick. The blast at the sides grows louder.
modular.feedback.desc.part.thermal_sleev: A sleeve shrunk onto the barrel. Loose cold, it closes on the barrel as it heats and tightens the group; left to get too hot it grips the bore and squeezes the chamber.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.thermal_fit: Loose when cold, tightest at a warm barrel, binding when it runs too hot. The sleeve takes up %1$s%% of the barrel's heat: a poor conductor closes late.
modular.feedback.desc.part.resonance_wei: A weight threaded on the barrel. Where it sits tunes the barrel to one muzzle speed: a round near it shoots tight, a round far from it shoots worse than a bare barrel.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.resonance: Tuned to one muzzle speed; the further the round is from it, the wider the group. Strays count %1$s%% as far as with an iron weight: a denser metal damps more.
modular.feedback.desc.part.counterweight: A dense mass that runs against the bolt and cancels kick. It slows the cycle, and a worn bore cuts its stroke short so it slaps the receiver instead.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bipod: Folding legs under the barrel. Crouched and still, they take the kick and tighten the group.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bayonet: A lug and blade under the barrel, for a thrust with the gun in hand.
modular.feedback.desc.part.selector_swit: A switch on the trigger group that lets the gun fire in bursts or automatic.
modular.feedback.desc.part.eddy_sleeve: A conductive sleeve at the muzzle. A bullet of the right metal drags on it as it leaves and slows.
modular.feedback.desc.part.relief_vent: A port in the receiver that bleeds gas when pressure climbs too high, sparing the gun some overpressure.
modular.feedback.desc.part.obturator: A ring set in the chamber mouth. Soft stuff seals better; fire eats it.
modular.feedback.desc.part.hydraulic_buf: A sealed chamber of thick fluid behind the bolt, taking the recoil.
modular.feedback.desc.part.lit_reticle: A speck of luminous mineral set in a ring of iron on the sight. It glows on its own, with no wire and no battery.
modular.feedback.desc.part.magnetic_sear: A small magnet that holds the sear against the trigger.
modular.feedback.desc.part.barrel_shroud: A jacket round the barrel. It sheds heat to the air so the gun cools sooner.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.recurve: Like bow limbs, but forged with a curl in each tip in a run of taps and heavy blows. A full draw hits harder and passes through a mob; a part draw is only an ordinary bow, and the draw is a little slower.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.hunting: Like bow limbs, but forged in a steady run of taps and left light. The shot is silent and an arrow to an animal's head hits much harder; it flies slower and hits softer on anything else.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.repeater: Like a crossbow prod, but forged with a rack in a run of light taps and heavies. One load takes three bolts from the quiver and one shot looses them all, scattered; each hits a little softer and loading takes longer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.kite: Like a shield face, but long and tapered: five lengths of stock. A projectile it stops is sent back where you look and hardly wears it; a melee blow is held to less.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.recurve: A full draw shoots an arrow that does %1$s%% more damage and passes through %2$s mob. A part draw gets neither. The draw takes %3$s%% of the time.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.stalker: The shot makes no sound. An arrow to an animal's head does x%1$s damage. The arrow leaves at %2$s%% of the speed and the draw takes %3$s%% of the time.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.repeater: Loading takes %1$s bolts from the quiver at once and one shot looses them all, scattered (x%4$s the usual spread). Loading takes %2$s%% of the time and each bolt does %3$s%% damage.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.parry: This shield parries on the parry key: a blow that lands in the %1$s s window is stopped whole and throws the attacker back. Raised for plain blocking it guards only a %2$s degree arc ahead and holds %3$s%% of what its face could.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.deflect: This shield deflects on the parry key: a projectile that lands in the window is sent back the way you look at %1$s%% of its speed. It does not parry a melee blow, and raised for plain blocking holds one to %2$s%% of what the face could.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.bulwark: Guards every angle once raised and holds %1$s%% of what a plain face could, but slows you %2$s%% and wears %3$s%% as fast. Use it while sprinting to bash instead: hostiles within %4$s blocks ahead take %5$s damage and are thrown back, at a cost of wear, hunger, your sprint and %6$s s before the shield can be raised again.
modular.feedback.role.box_feed.tip: A box of rounds that feeds the action: reloads in one piece, and holds more rounds than a tube.
modular.feedback.role.thermal_sleeve.tip: A sleeve round the barrel that tightens as it heats: a cold barrel throws wider, a warm one groups tighter, a hot one binds.
modular.feedback.role.counterweight.tip: A weight in the buffer: less kick, a slower cycle, and a slap of kick when the action returns.
modular.feedback.role.bipod.tip: Folding legs under the gun: much less kick and spread when braced.
modular.feedback.role.bayonet.tip: A blade on the barrel lug: lets you stab with the gun in hand.
modular.feedback.role.selector.tip: A switch on the receiver that gives select fire.
modular.feedback.role.resonance.tip: A weight threaded on the barrel that tunes its ring: further toward the muzzle tunes a faster shot.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.handgun: Held in one hand, no stock: nothing braces it, so kick and spread are the wrist's. Pistol, revolver, derringer and machine pistol are all this.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.machine_gu: A heavy frame built for sustained fire from an open bolt. Its trouble is heat, not aim.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.self_loadi: Cycles off the shot, one round a pull.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.automatic: Cycles off the shot and keeps firing while the trigger is held; select fire.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.bolt: A manual bolt: slow between shots, locked tight into the barrel.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.lever: Worked by a lever under the grip; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.pump: Worked by a sliding forend; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.break: The barrels hinge open to load; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.single_act: A hammer you cock with your thumb between shots: slow, deliberate, and it groups tight. Takes a cylinder.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.double_act: The trigger cocks and drops the hammer: nothing to work between shots, but a looser group. Takes a cylinder.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.revolver: Rounds wait in a turning cylinder; with a hammer it can be fanned.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.belt: The rounds are a chain: a long reload, and a belt as long as the chain.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.reflex: Aims with a modest zoom, quickly raised.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.scope: A lot of zoom, slowly raised.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.hammer: A hammer strikes the primer. It lets a cylinder be fitted and fanned.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.manual_cycle: The next round is brought up by the shooter: this much longer between shots, in the cycle figure.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.select_fire: Semi, burst or full automatic, switched in hand.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.double_barre: Two barrels side by side. Sneaking while you pull fires both at once for one recoil.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.closed_bolt: A round sits in the hot chamber: above its charge's ignition temperature it cooks off on its own.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.blowback: Only the bolt's mass holds the breech shut. A round that makes more than %1$s Pu kicks harder in proportion and wears the bore x%2$s faster by the excess.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.lockup: How firmly the action holds the breech shut: the chamber is rated at %1$s%% of the barrel's hoop strength, and the group is tighter by %2$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.gas_operated: The gas works the action: a cycle %1$s%% quicker that pressure does not hurt, paid in %2$s%% more heat and %3$s Mu of piston.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.off_hand: Fires from the off hand on the use key. A one-handed gun in each hand fires one on each button, each with its own count; a reload then takes much longer.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.bayonet: A fixed blade under the barrel. Gun-fu Bayonet Drill thrusts with it for %1$s damage (the blade metal's hardness).
modular.feedback.desc.trait.gun_braced: Crouched and still, the stock takes the kick: %1$s%% less (a soft, tough pad) and %2$s%% tighter (how stiff its core is).
modular.feedback.desc.trait.open_bolt: Fires from an open bolt: nothing in the chamber to cook off. After %1$s s without firing the first shot sprays x%2$s wider.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.belt_fed: The rounds are a chain: a reload takes x%1$s as long.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.fan: Crouched, hold the attack button to slap the hammer as fast as the hand can: a rate no cycle limit gives, with the spread, kick and cylinder heat that costs.
feedback.gloss.modular.overstressed: the reference charge makes more pressure than the chamber is rated for (overpressure above 1)
modular.feedback.fig.peak_pressure.tip: What the reference charge makes in the case.
modular.feedback.fig.chamber_rating.tip: The most the chamber holds: the barrel's metal and wall. Past it the gun takes the force.
modular.feedback.fig.muzzle_speed.tip: How fast the bullet leaves, at the reference load.
modular.feedback.fig.muzzle_energy.tip: Energy delivered to the bullet, in Wu: bore, barrel length and pressure.
modular.feedback.fig.impulse.tip: Momentum of bullet and gas: what recoil is made from.
modular.feedback.fig.cycle.tip: Time between shots, including the hand's work on a manual action.
modular.feedback.fig.spread.tip: Cone half-angle at the muzzle; never zero.
modular.feedback.fig.kick.tip: Camera kick per shot: impulse over the gun's mass, less what the grip lets through.
modular.feedback.fig.report.tip: How loud a shot is against an open muzzle.
modular.feedback.fig.heat_factor.tip: Heat a shot leaves in the gun against an open muzzle.
modular.feedback.fig.shed_factor.tip: How fast the barrel sheds heat against a bare one.
modular.feedback.fig.overpressure.tip: Charge pressure over the chamber rating. Above 1 the force goes into the gun.
gun.feedback.build: %1$s mm bore, %2$s m barrel, %3$s mm wall, %4$s sight, %5$s
gui.feedback.tool_table.tip.round: A loaded round. Nothing is spent.
tooltip.feedback.blueprint.fine: Fine: a quarter of the parts, for finespace
tooltip.feedback.fine_build: Fine build: stands only in finespace
message.feedback.fine_build.finespace_on: A fine build stands only in finespace
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.rig.tip: Test rig: runs the drawn item in a loop. Swing speed, reach, dig pace, draw, launch speed, joint and shield capacity are the figures beside it, moving.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.joint: %1$s and %2$s: this joint is at %3$s%% of its limit
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.pin.tip: Pin this draft. Each pinned draft puts a colored mark on every bar to compare against; up to three.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.unpin: Click to open a pinned draft, Shift-click to drop it.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.rows.hint: Hold Shift for the figure. Click to sort the materials by it: most, least, off.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.f: This action cannot work this feed.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.s: A second barrel needs a break action with no feed.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.f: Only one feed fits a gun.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.m: This part's material cannot be built into a gun.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.fault.s: A long gun or machine gun receiver needs a stock.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.remove: Take this part off the drawing
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.round: Test round. Put a cartridge here to read the drawn gun against it.
gui.feedback.round_test.title: Round test
gui.feedback.round_test.ideal: On paper: the parts exactly to drawing.
gui.feedback.round_test.heat: Heat: %1$s Tu a shot, sheds %2$s Tu a second
gui.feedback.round_test.damage: Up to %1$s damage a hit, every Work landing
gui.feedback.round_test.overpressure: The charge asks %1$s%% of what the chamber holds.
gui.feedback.round_test.rifled: A shot charge does not fire from a rifled bore.
gui.feedback.round_test.bore: A %1$s mm bore does not chamber a %2$s mm round.
gui.feedback.round_test.unfit: This round cannot be fired from this gun.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.paper: Blueprint paper. A printed one opens to edit.
modular.feedback.role.barrel.tip: Where the bullet is guided. Its bore sets the caliber; length sets muzzle speed against weight.
modular.feedback.role.receiver.tip: The frame everything else bolts to. In a powder gun its shape decides what kind of gun this is; in a spring gun it is what the spring is rated against.
modular.feedback.role.second_barrel.tip: A second tube beside the first. Two shots ready, more weight and kick to hold.
modular.feedback.role.slide.tip: Reciprocating cover that cycles the action by blowback: self-loading.
modular.feedback.role.bolt.tip: A bolt that locks the breech: a stronger action, worked by hand or gas.
modular.feedback.role.trigger.tip: Releases the action. Sits in the receiver.
modular.feedback.role.grip.tip: What the hand holds. Sets how the gun settles under recoil.
modular.feedback.role.cylinder.tip: A cylinder that holds air for the mask. A thicker wall of a stronger metal holds more.
modular.feedback.role.tube.tip: A tube under the barrel holding rounds in a row.
modular.feedback.role.belt.tip: A belt of linked rounds feeding a machine gun.
modular.feedback.role.sight.tip: Aiming aid. Tightens how well you hit where you point.
modular.feedback.role.suppressor.tip: Baffled can on the muzzle: quieter and less flash, at some cost to speed.
modular.feedback.role.muzzle_brake.tip: Vents gas sideways to tame recoil.
modular.feedback.role.eddy_sleeve.tip: A conducting sleeve on the muzzle that drags a magnetic bullet as it passes.
modular.feedback.role.vent.tip: Lets heat and gas out of the action.
modular.feedback.role.obturator.tip: A soft ring that seals a loose chamber: the softer the stuff, the less kick and the tighter the group. Burns away once the barrel is hotter than the stuff can take.
modular.feedback.role.hydraulic_buffer.t: A sealed chamber of thick fluid the recoil must push through: much less kick, a slower cycle. The fluid thins as the barrel heats. Must be made of something sticky.
modular.feedback.role.lit_reticle.tip: A dot of glowing mineral in the sight, with no battery to run flat. Tightens the group in the dark; washed out in daylight. Must be made of something luminous.
modular.feedback.role.magnetic_sear.tip: A magnet holds the sear: a cleaner break and a quicker reset, with no power drawn waiting. Its pull fades as the barrel heats, and a non-magnetic stuff has none.
modular.feedback.role.shroud.tip: A cover around the barrel that sheds heat.
modular.feedback.role.head.tip: The business end. Its material and shape set damage and dig speed.
modular.feedback.role.second_head.tip: The other end of a twin-headed tool.
modular.feedback.role.handle.tip: What you hold. Longer handles reach further and swing slower.
modular.feedback.role.binding.tip: Lashing where head meets handle. Takes some of the shock.
modular.feedback.role.tip.tip: A hard piece set into the working edge. Lends it hardness.
modular.feedback.role.blade.tip: The cutting part. Its material sets edge, wear and damage.
modular.feedback.role.guard.tip: Stops a blow sliding down onto the hand.
modular.feedback.role.pommel.tip: Counterweight at the hand end: moves the balance back.
modular.feedback.role.haft.tip: The long shaft of a polearm.
modular.feedback.role.shaft.tip: The long body: stiffer shafts fly truer.
modular.feedback.role.face.tip: The striking face of a shield or mace.
modular.feedback.role.rim.tip: Edge of a shield, takes the brunt of blows.
modular.feedback.role.limbs.tip: The springy arms of a bow: they store the energy.
modular.feedback.role.string.tip: Carries the limbs' energy to the arrow.
modular.feedback.role.lock.tip: The flint and its hammer. Pulling the trigger snaps the flint on the pan: it takes a moment to prime and cock again, and the priming sometimes flashes without firing the charge.
modular.feedback.role.pivot.tip: The hinge the blades turn on.
modular.feedback.role.plate.tip: The main armor. Better plate takes more of every blow.
modular.feedback.role.lining.tip: Padding worn under the plate; it softens what gets through.
modular.feedback.role.studs.tip: Hard studs set into plate. They bite whoever strikes you in melee.
modular.feedback.role.collar.tip: A ring about the neck: it takes a share of a critical hit or a backstab. Plate is stiff and takes more; chain and leather give.
modular.feedback.role.pauldron.tip: A plate over the shoulder: it turns overhead blows and falling blocks.
modular.feedback.role.poleyn.tip: Caps over the knee: they soften a fall and a kick.
modular.feedback.role.vambrace.tip: A cuff on the forearm: it turns a light blow when the hand is empty and keeps a disarm from taking the hand's hold.
modular.feedback.role.spurs.tip: Spurs on the heel: starting a sprint gives a burst of speed.
modular.feedback.role.hobnails.tip: Nails through the sole: they bite ice but ring on stone.
modular.feedback.role.underlayer.tip: Padding or mail worn under the plate; it softens what gets through.
modular.feedback.role.spring.tip: A spring of wire or rod fitted to the weapon. Its volume and stiffness set what it stores; the head it sits in sets what it can take.
modular.feedback.role.magazine.tip: A box of plate or plank on the crossbow. Its volume sets how many bolts a load takes.
modular.feedback.role.cooling.tip: Fins or a water jacket on a motor housing. More material sheds more heat.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.no_pape: Put paper in the slot to print.
item.feedback.unlearning_token.used: You unlearn everything. Your points are returned.
item.feedback.unlearning_token.nothing: You have learned nothing to unlearn.
skill.feedback.tree.chaos.desc: Leaves targets with what you did to them, and it spreads: worn armor stays worn, stripped weapons stay stripped, fire passes to the next body, a shove knocks one body into another.
skill.feedback.move.rend.desc: Cast: a short blow that grinds worn armor. Each piece loses durability by your weapon's hardness against its own; your weapon wears by the hardest piece. Nothing worn, nothing happens. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.sunder.desc: Cast: a heavy blow into the target's shield or weapon. A raised shield is split and disabled; a held weapon is worn, and struck from the hand if yours is half again as hard. Your weapon wears too. A pack bottle breaks on the body it opens. Rearms on a stagger. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.kindle.desc: Cast: touch a held item above the burn line to the ground ahead. Flammable blocks and creatures within two blocks catch fire, longer the hotter the item, and it spreads body to body. The item cools and scalds your hand. Rearms on a landed blow. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.barge.desc: Cast: a shoulder into the body ahead. It is staggered by your mass (armor counts) and sent along your line, faster the more you outweigh it. A body too heavy to move is not shoved. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.stampede.desc: Cast: a roar sends every burning creature within nine blocks bolting away at a gallop, carrying fire into whatever they pass. Rearms on a stagger. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_powder_burn.d: A close shot sets the target alight for four seconds, unless water or fire resistance puts it out.
skill.feedback.figure.carry_ratio: Carry up to %s times more of your weight
skill.feedback.move.fist_jab.desc: A standing unarmed blow reaches a little further. It starts the chain: a move landing soon after the previous one hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.fist_lunge.desc: A sprinting unarmed blow staggers half again as hard and guards you for a few ticks. It follows Jab in the chain (30% harder) and needs a run.
skill.feedback.move.fist_sweep.desc: A standing unarmed blow also strikes everything in a wide arc in front at part damage. It follows Jab in the chain (30% harder) and needs you standing still.
skill.feedback.move.fist_chop.desc: A falling unarmed blow drives the target down. It follows Lunge in the chain (30% harder) and needs you to be falling.
skill.feedback.move.rising_uppercut.desc: Upgrade to Uppercut: crouch while casting and a landed punch drives you up with the body. You take the landing. A miss still staggers you.
skill.feedback.move.uppercut.desc: Cast, bare-handed: a quick windup, then a punch for seven damage plus a worn plate's fist damage that launches a body about seven blocks up. A miss staggers you. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_brand.desc: A whip with the barrel above the burn line sears the target by the barrel's temperature and takes some of its heat; the more you fired first, the harder it brands. A hot barrel burns your hand too.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_muzzle_stagge: A point-blank shot just after a whip staggers the target by the round's impulse over its mass, so a heavy bore shoves hard. You must be on top of them, and it is spent until you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_bayonet.desc: With a bayonet lug fitted, the swing is a thrust on the gun's own cycle, hitting by the bayonet metal's hardness. You build and carry the lug.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_braced.desc: Recoil is momentum. Opens the recoil techniques.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_roll_with_kic: A loose, giving body: every shot kicks the view and hand less and spreads less.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_braced_fire.d: Shooting braced (crouched against a block, or in the air against a wall) sheds most of the heat bloom of the spread, so it needs terrain to lean on.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_hot_clear.des: Sneak-reload with the barrel near cook-off ejects the chambered round unfired. It only helps where cook-off is a danger.
Rolling through an attack clears the gun's cycle wait, so the next shot is ready at once. The roll must cross a blow, and it rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_spent_case_dr: Reloading during a roll takes only as long as the roll has left, so the roll must be long enough to finish it.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_return_fire.d: A weapon parry in its window turns an arrow or thrown thing back along its path; bullets are too fast. It needs the parry timing, and the blow wears the weapon.
skill.feedback.move.quake_leap.desc: Cast: vault forward and up, and land hard. The landing staggers everything in reach by your mass (armor counts) and fall height over each target's mass. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.whirl.desc: Cast: a full turn with the held weapon, hitting everything in reach at four-fifths damage and staggering by that damage over mass. Rearms on a stagger. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.forge_slam.desc: Cast: slam an item above the burn line into the ground. A ring of searing goes out by its temperature, and the item gives up heat to it. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.flurry.desc: Cast, empty-handed: six quick blows on whoever you face, the last one a stagger. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.pummel_pin.desc: Rider on Pummel: a target light enough to grab is held still for all six blows, in mid-air too, and so are you. If still airborne at the last blow, it launches hard along your look. Bodies too heavy to grab are not pinned.
skill.feedback.move.shadow_step.desc: Cast: a fast flanking sidestep of three or four blocks toward the blind side of the nearest thing in front, within nine blocks. A wall stops it short; a blow or bump ends it. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.ambush.desc: The first blow within three seconds of a Shadow step staggers its target by the blow over its mass, tripled, whatever it faces.
skill.feedback.move.walking_fire.desc: Cast: three rounds from the held gun, each at the next target in front, so one press sweeps a room. Each round heats the barrel and spends ammo. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.muzzle_flash.desc: Cast: fire the gun as a blast. The round's impulse staggers everything in the cone in front, and the flash blinds it. A heavy bore staggers a lot. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.dead_eye.desc: Always on: a shot taken crouched and still leaves exact, with no spread, and counts twice as hard against armor.
skill.feedback.move.dropkick.desc: Cast, in the air: dive forward and down; the landing kicks what is under you, by your mass (armor counts) over its. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.brace.desc: Always on while crouched: knockback cannot move you, and each blow is held by your mass (armor counts) against the attacker's. The held share goes into the attacker as stagger and wears your weapon.
skill.feedback.move.shield_wall.desc: Cast, with a shield or blocking item: for three seconds, anything coming inside the front cone is turned back and staggered once, by its mass and speed. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.reckoning.desc: Cast: the energy of the last blow you parried, within five seconds, returns through your weapon as one strike at what you face, staggering it by twice that. Rearms on a stagger. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.reprisal.desc: Always on: every parry you land is answered at once with a blow at whoever struck, for your attack damage, and staggers them.
skill.feedback.move.pin_down.desc: Always on, with a gun: any round passing close to a living thing slows it hard for two seconds, hit or not. Area denial from a gun not trying to hit.
skill.feedback.move.hamstring.desc: Cast: a low cut at what you face for seven tenths damage that cripples its legs: slowed hard for four seconds. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.mark_and_fire.desc: Held cast, revolver: hold your sights on things; each beat marks one more chambered round (a thing can take several). On release, full cylinder or empty bar, you swing to each mark and shoot it exactly, two ticks apart. Slow walk, six seconds. Costs 10 stamina, then 4 a second.
skill.feedback.move.coin_flip.desc: Cast: toss a coin and shoot it. A harder coin than the round rebounds it to the nearest thing within 24 blocks with a clear line; a softer one is punched through. Uses up a stamped coin and 15 stamina, and rearms on a landed blow or 30 s out of a fight.
skill.feedback.move.second_mark.desc: Coin flip may be used twice: a second coin goes up while the first is airborne, and a rebound goes into the other coin first. It uses a second stamped coin and 15 stamina, and the shot must be fast.
skill.feedback.move.round_the_corner.des: The rebound looks three times as far for a target. It still needs a clear line from the coin, and it gives up the second press.
skill.feedback.move.searing_strike.desc: Any held item above the burn line sears what a landed blow hits, and cools. A hot item burns your hand.
skill.feedback.move.feint.desc: With a one-handed weapon in each hand, an off-hand strike pressed mid-swing cuts in at once at full strength and the target flinches. It is spent until you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.draw_switch.desc: Swapping to a weapon of a different build family returns the swing at once instead of restarting the recharge. It needs two kinds of weapon and rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.last_stand.desc: A hit leaving you at 3 hearts or less makes the next roll that swallows a blow a free parry: the attacker is staggered and your riposte opens. It takes a hit to arm and rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.kick.desc: Cast: drive a kick into what is in front: a stagger from your mass (armor counts) against the target's. Gear can grant it. Wall Smash and Breach Kick build on it.
skill.feedback.move.grab.desc: Cast, bare-handed: take hold of what is in front. A worn glove gives a longer hold and heavier targets. Throw and the grip nodes build on it.
skill.feedback.move.shove.desc: Cast, held: hands on a vehicle body. One no heavier than you and armor is held up like a prop; a heavier one is shoved or dragged by your mass times speed, and pushes back equally. Tires and brakes resist. Costs stamina for work done. Earns Brute points, fewer on repeats.
skill.feedback.move.throw.desc: Release a staggered body you hold (a grab, or a grapple that reached you) along your look; mass decides how far. It leaves you in reach and recovering, and is spent until you stagger something.
skill.feedback.move.size_up.desc: Cast: read the creature under your crosshair (24 blocks, in sight) for fifteen seconds: armor, toughness, health and what it gives away now. Every weakness skill here works only on a read creature. Costs 15 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.hardness_gap.desc: A blow on a read creature lands 3% harder per point your weapon's edge exceeds its armor's hardness, up to 40%. An unarmored creature has no seams; a bare hand counts as soft.
skill.feedback.move.soft_spot.desc: Cast: pick a worn piece (head, chest, legs or feet) on a read creature. The next blow within three seconds ignores 4% of its armor and toughness per point, up to 50%. Costs 25 stamina; rearms on a strike.
skill.feedback.move.opening.desc: A blow on a read creature lands harder per opening: facing away 25%, unaware or asleep 25%, burning 20%, wet 10%, staggered 30%, up to 80%.
skill.feedback.move.exploit.desc: Cast: spend the read on one blow. For three seconds the next hit on that creature lands 50% harder, plus every opening, and the read is used up. Costs 30 stamina; rearms on a strike.
skill.feedback.move.tell.desc: A read creature that swings is open for a dozen ticks after it hits: 30% more to the next blow.
skill.feedback.move.pressure_point.desc: A blow on a read creature that is staggered or just swung staggers it again by mass ratio: a light fighter can topple a heavy body. Rearms stagger casts.
skill.feedback.move.culling.desc: A read creature under 30% health is open: 20% more to the blow that ends it.
skill.feedback.move.edge.desc: A blow on a read creature with a drop, lava, fire, magma block or cactus one or two blocks behind it lands 25% harder and shoves it that way.
skill.feedback.move.quench.desc: A hot weapon or gun barrel on a wet read creature gives steam: up to 40% more damage by heat, and the weapon cools 80 Tu.
skill.feedback.move.right_tool.desc: A blow on a read creature lands 30% harder against its weakness class: bone to blunt, thin hide to pierce, worn cloth or leather to slash, cold dry air to fire, wet skin to shock. Size up names the class.
skill.feedback.move.conductor.desc: Shock hurts a read creature 50% more while it is wet or in heavy armor.
skill.feedback.move.case_file.desc: Every kill of a creature type adds 1% to your blows against it, up to 20%, read or not. Kept across deaths.
skill.feedback.move.pattern.desc: After ten kills of a creature type, Size up reads it twice as long and shows what it hits for.
skill.feedback.move.herd_read.desc: Size up also reads every creature of the same kind within six blocks of the one you looked at.
skill.feedback.move.read_the_room.desc: Size up on a player also reads their gun in words: empty, one round left, barrel hot.
skill.feedback.move.spoor.desc: Cast: footprints and broken or placed blocks within sixteen blocks over the last minute show as scuffs of the ground's own dust, for a minute. Only signs left while you were near show. Costs 20 stamina.
slot.feedback.head: head
skill.feedback.move.read_the_draw.desc: Always on: in clear sight within forty-eight blocks, a spark flickers over a creature drawing a bow or crossbow, or a mob aiming a gun at someone. Nothing shows through walls. Needs no read.
skill.feedback.move.quarry_mark.desc: A ranged bow or crossbow hit makes the target bleed as long as the arrow carried energy, and leaves blood drops only you see for half a minute. Nothing within six blocks is marked, and neither is a dead target.
skill.feedback.move.far_sight.desc: A hard-drawn arrow flies flat for its first second, so a long shot needs no lead. It needs a near-full draw and drops after the second.
skill.feedback.move.point_blank_draw.des: A bow or crossbow hit within four blocks staggers the target by arrow energy over its mass. Twin of Muzzle stagger: you must be on top of them.
skill.feedback.move.barbed_shaft.desc: A close bow or crossbow hit pins the target, slowed hard until it breaks free after five seconds or you strike it. You must be close.
skill.feedback.move.braced_draw.desc: An arrow loosed braced against terrain (crouched against a block, or on a wall) leaves exactly down your sight line. Twin of Braced fire: you must be braced.
skill.feedback.move.snap_shot.desc: After a roll that swallowed a blow, your next arrow leaves at full draw however briefly drawn. Twin of Dodge charge: the roll must cross a blow, and the chance fades after three seconds.
skill.feedback.move.quarry_breath.desc: Killing at range with a bow or crossbow gives back stamina by the arrow's energy. Twin of Hot clear: the kill must be six blocks or more away.
skill.feedback.move.far_end.desc: Blows at the tip of your reach hit harder, more the more head-heavy the weapon, but give nothing up close. Excludes Close work.
skill.feedback.move.close_work.desc: Blows inside half your reach recharge the swing faster, but give nothing at the tip. Excludes Far end.
skill.feedback.move.pry_open.desc: A blow on a target whose weapon was just beaten (staggered, or guard up) binds that hand, longer for softer, more worn steel; a raised shield is disabled instead. It also doses the hand with the pack's potion. It only works on an opening and is spent until you parry.
skill.feedback.move.wall_smash.desc: A kick that sends a foe into a wall adds the weight of their armor to the stagger, so it needs a wall at their back.
skill.feedback.move.wall_rebound.desc: A wall kick keeps its momentum for one more kick off a second wall before you land, so it needs a second wall.
skill.feedback.move.breach_kick.desc: A kick on a staggered target knocks it down; on a steady one it only shoves.
skill.feedback.figure.running_bolt: Open-bolt sustained fire spread and kick %s (fraction off)
skill.feedback.move.forge_cadence.desc: Always on, at the forge: every three clean blows raise your tempo a step, and each blow at a step lands 8% harder per step. A miss drops tempo to nothing. Clean streaks earn Onslaught points, less for repeated shapes.
skill.feedback.move.forge_steady.desc: Always on, at the forge: a loose blow (near the beat, not on it) holds your tempo instead of dropping it, once per run. A miss still drops it.
skill.feedback.move.throwback.desc: A parry with the off hand empty returns the attacker's stagger doubled, and the riposte window is your free counter. It needs a free hand, so no shield or dual wield.
skill.feedback.move.slip.desc: A parry on the window's last tick becomes a step-through: the blow whiffs and you end up behind the attacker. The last tick is narrow, and a missed slip is normal recovery.
skill.feedback.move.answer.desc: The first blow after a clean parry is blocked outright. The guard rearms only when you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.roll_with_it.desc: A parry on the last tick takes the blow on the weapon's flat: excess force becomes stagger on the attacker instead of weapon wear. It needs the late tick.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_heavy_butt.de: A pistol-whip shoves the target half again as hard.
skill.feedback.move.riposte.desc: After a successful parry, your next melee hit within 1.5 s (30 ticks) deals 1.5x damage.
skill.feedback.move.wall_kick.desc: Tap jump in the air facing a wall, within 1.2 s of sprinting or rolling, to kick off it up and back. Costs hunger; resets fall distance.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_pistol_whip.d: Barehanded, attacking with a held gun swings it as a bludgeon. Damage and recovery follow the gun's mass.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_chamber.desc: A pistol-whip heavy enough to stagger fires a free shot at the target. Needs a loaded gun; one stagger, one shot.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_dual.desc: The off-hand gun can pistol-whip too, on its own cooldown.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_spin.desc: Sneak while pistol-whipping to spin: hits every body within 2 blocks, with 1.5x longer recovery.
skill.feedback.move.blade_flourish.desc: A landed blade hit takes 10 ticks off the roll cooldown (parry and kick wait on it too).
skill.feedback.move.mace_quake.desc: A blow of 5+ damage, from any weapon or a plated fist, shakes the ground: bodies within 2.5 blocks of the target are knocked back and staggered.
skill.feedback.move.spear_vault.desc: A spear thrust landed while sprinting on the ground vaults you up and forward. 2 s cooldown.
tooltip.feedback.potion.throw: Sneak and use to throw: it acts on the place it lands and everything in reach
tooltip.feedback.potion.drink_ignite: Do not drink. It sets the drinker alight.
tooltip.feedback.potion.drink_explosion: Do not drink. It detonates on the drinker.
feedback.stand.nothing: Needs water and something in it.
feedback.stand.dud: The brew comes out a dud.
feedback.stand.status: %s bottles of water, %s ingredients, %s bottles waiting
gui.feedback.stand.title: Brewing Stand
gui.feedback.stand.hint: Stir in circles over the map. Hover a plant in your inventory or the pot to see the curve it would add.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.part.off: Seat a part in the slot.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.heat.ok: Hot: the session costs less, but the part cools while you write and the window closes.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.heat.off: Cold: full price, but the part never runs out of time.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.effect.no: The part has no room for more, or no rite of this effect stands by the table.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.effect.off: Pick an effect from the list.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.xp.off: A session costs %s. A Creative XP source beside the table can pay it.
message.feedback.enchant.attuned: This part can take no more attunements.
message.feedback.enchant.lost: The session was lost. Nothing was spent; try again.
message.feedback.enchant.nothing: Nothing took. The experience is gone.
message.feedback.enchant.flawed: The enchantment took, but the part is flawed.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.draw_round: Bends the round toward heavy armor (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.draw_round: bends the fired round toward the nearest heavily armored living thing ahead, keeping its speed. Goes dead when the barrel is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.fling_round: Bends the round away from heavy armor (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.fling_roun: bends the fired round away from heavily armored living things ahead, keeping its speed. Goes dead when the barrel is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.wet_round: Round keeps its speed under water (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.wet_round: lets the fired round keep its speed through water.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.dry_round: loses a share of the round's damage on a target that is not in water.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.charged_round: Arcs a share of each hit (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.charged_ro: arcs a share of each hit to the nearest other living thing within a few blocks that is wet or in heavy armor, and calls lightning on a sky-exposed target in a thunderstorm.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.grounded_r: sheds charge into the ground: the target takes a share less damage.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.channel: draws lightning to the holder in a thunderstorm under open sky, and calls a bolt on everything it hits, or on the ground a slam strikes.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.channel.ma: the winding loses less to resistance.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.channel.fo: the foil carries a harder discharge.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.draw: Draws the drops of what you kill to you (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.draw: sends the drops of whatever the blow kills flying to the wielder. Goes dead when the part is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.fling: Throws the drops of what you kill away (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.fling: throws the drops of whatever the blow kills away from the wielder. Goes dead when the part is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.fling.mach: the core throws the magnetic items it would draw, and reaches further.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_draw: while worn, loose items nearby drift toward you. Goes dead when the part is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_fling: while worn, arrows and tridents with metal in them are turned aside before they hit you. Goes dead when the part is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.ring: a landed blow rings, so sculk and nearby hostile mobs notice it from further.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.ring.machi: it rings a vibration every few seconds that sculk and wandering hostile mobs notice.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.hush: A landed blow makes no sound (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.hush: the blow and the hurt it causes make no vibration for sculk to feel.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.hush.machi: it silences the vibrations made near it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_ring: while worn, your steps and the hits you take ring, so sculk and nearby hostile mobs notice you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_hush: Worn: steps and hits are silent (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_hush: while worn, your steps and the hits you take make no vibration for sculk to feel.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.stick: A landed blow sticks and slows (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.stick: a landed blow sticks to the target and slows it, longer the grippier the material.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.slick: A landed blow knocks the target sliding (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.slick: a landed blow knocks the target further along, more the slipperier the material.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.slick.mach: the flywheel drags less in the air and on its bearings.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_grip: stops a slide on slippery ground when you are not pushing, more the grippier the material. Boots only.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_slick: lets you skate faster on any ground but stops poorly. Boots only.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pest_ward: keeps pests from the food in it, so it rots more slowly.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pest_lure: draws pests to the food in it, so it rots faster.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.cure: passes a field through the food in it, so it rots more slowly.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.nourish: eaten, the meal fills more food points.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.thin: eaten, the meal fills fewer food points.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.restore: eaten, the meal closes wear on the gear you wear.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.tithe_meal: eaten, the meal pays out experience points.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.glow: while held, carries a light that moves with you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.glow.machi: the filament gives its light on less current.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.glow.meal: the food in it rots more slowly (light kills what grows).
tooltip.feedback.attuned.dim: Held: hides you in the dark (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.dim: while held, hostile mobs beyond a short range do not take you up as a target while you stand in low light.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.dim.machin: the filament runs cooler and burns out later.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_glow: while worn, carries a light that moves with you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_dim: Worn: hides you in the dark (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_dim: while worn, hostile mobs beyond a short range do not take you up as a target while you stand in low light.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_lure: while worn, draws passive animals nearby toward you, no item in hand needed.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_scare: Worn: scatters animals and weak monsters (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_scare: while worn, animals and weak hostile mobs nearby keep their distance from you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_grow: Worn on boots: walking grows crops and grass (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_grow: walking grows crops and spreads grass underfoot every few blocks. Boots only.
walking spills seed and grows crops underfoot.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_reap: Worn on boots: walking reaps ripe crops (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_reap: walking over ripe crops harvests and replants them every few blocks. Boots only.
walking harvests and replants ripe crops underfoot.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_reserve: Worn: sprinting and fighting cost less hunger (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_reser: cuts the hunger you burn from sprinting and fighting.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_famine: Worn: whoever hits you loses hunger (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_famin: whoever hits you loses food if a player, or is weakened if a mob.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_sprint: Worn on legs or boots: the longer you run straight, the faster (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_sprin: the longer you run in a straight line the faster you go, to a cap; stopping or a sharp turn resets it. Legs and boots only.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_stance: Worn: standing still builds damage reduction (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_stanc: the longer you stand still the less damage you take, to a cap; moving resets it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.momentum: Hits harder after a straight sprint (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.momentum: hits harder and knocks further the longer you ran in a straight line before the blow; a spear jab after a sprint is the best hit.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.brace: hits harder the longer you have stood still; moving breaks it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.brace.mach: the rim holds to a higher speed before it lets go.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.pack: Hits harder for each ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pack: hits harder for each ally within a few blocks: same team, same tamed owner, or a golem.
As a machine head: a seated head's stroke hits harder for each other attuned machine within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.pack_guard: Takes less from a hit for each ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pack_guard: turns away more of a hit for each ally within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.lone: Hits harder with no ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lone: hits harder when no ally is within a few blocks.
As a machine head: a seated head's stroke hits harder when no other attuned machine stands within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.lone_guard: Takes less from a hit with no ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lone_guard: turns away more of a hit when no ally is within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.mark: marks the target, which glows; the next blow on it, from anyone, does extra.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.mark.machi: hostile mobs within a few blocks are marked.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.taunt: Draws hostile mobs onto the wearer (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.taunt: marks its wearer, so hostile mobs nearby turn on them. Brittle.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.echo_blow: Repeats each blow a beat later (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.echo_blow: repeats each blow on the same target a beat later, at a share of its damage.
As a machine head: each stroke of a hammer or press carries the repeat too.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.echo_wear: wears the part extra on every hit you take. The damage is unchanged.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lag_blow: makes each swing land a few seconds after it is struck.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lag_blow.a: As a machine head: each stroke lands one stroke late; a stroke held too long is lost.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lag_hit: puts off a share of each hit you take and delivers it over the next few seconds.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.gamble: flips a coin on each blow: it lands for double damage, or heals the target instead.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.gamble.als: As a machine head: each stroke of a hammer or press is double or does nothing.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.gamble_war: flips a coin on each hit you take: it does double damage, or none at all.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.feed: restores food and saturation on a kill, and costs a little hunger on every blow.
As a machine head: a working machine feeds the saturation of the crew within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.drain: takes food from a player it hits, and weakens a mob.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.drain.also: As a machine head: a working machine takes the strength out of the crew within a few blocks and weakens hostile mobs there.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.grudge: Damage you take fills the charge bar (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.grudge: damage the wearer takes is stored in the charge bar of the Charge tool in hand, to be spent by the next release.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.grudge.mac: a blast that would break the housing is taken (with a chance per level) and the damage kept, then given back to the nearest hostile creature within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.calm: Damage you take drains the charge bar (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.calm: damage the wearer takes bleeds stored charge from the Charge tool in hand.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.calm.machi: a blast that would break the housing is taken (with a chance per level) and shed.

tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.reap: a swing at the ground harvests and replants ripe crops in a small area, then cools down.

tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pulse.also: As a machine head: a seated head of a hammer or press charges a Leyden jar or battery beside the machine a little per stroke.
